name: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City) Sweet Banana, Butter & Sugar or Nutella Crepe
brandOrRestaurant: Crepes and Coffee (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Warm thin crepe filled with sliced ripe bananas and butter/cinnamon-sugar (or smooth hazelnut-chocolate Nutella)—100% seedless unlike the Bear Lake Raspberry crepe.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the Classic Butter & Sugar with Banana or the Nutella-Banana crepe; skip the Bear Lake Raspberry crepe if avoiding berry seeds.
watchOuts: Skip the Bear Lake Raspberry crepe during flares (seeds)
Nutella contains skim milk powder (take a Lactaid if sensitive)
